resources.string: Changes will be sent as new copies under your selected sender identity, without the original forward header. Applying edits shows captions; Hide caption can suppress them afterwards. Formatting follows the edited text.
This selection contains content that cannot be edited safely (such as polls, buttons, rich posts or expiring media), or more than 100 messages. You can still forward it unchanged.
Enter text within %1$d characters. A text message cannot be empty.
